lead.hed: USS John Basilone arrived in Rota, completing the shift from Mayport
lead.insight: A Navy photograph posted Wednesday shows a brow secured to the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS John Basilone (DDG 122) after the ship arrived at Naval Station Rota, Spain. The caption says the arrival on Oct. 14 completed the homeport shift from Mayport, Florida. The photograph was taken Oct. 13 by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Alyssa Sperle. Rota is the Navy's forward hub for destroyers covering Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

political.hed: American children get far more vaccine doses than children abroad
political.insight: Thursday's Heritage commentary says childhood vaccination policies vary widely by country, and that American children receive up to 75 vaccine doses, twice as many as children in other countries. It says that disparity is why a confirmed FDA director, if Dr. Heidi Overton is confirmed, would put the schedule near the top of the job.

political.hed: The left is dusting off old arguments to weaken the Court
political.insight: Thursday's Law & Liberty book review says progressive writers are rediscovering century-old arguments for crippling the Supreme Court.

tech.hed: Kratos and Airbus flew the U740 Valkyrie combat drone over Europe
tech.insight: Defense News reports that Kratos and Airbus said the U740 Valkyrie completed a first European test flight this week, built for German and other European forces. The companies said the flight met its goals: a rocket-assisted takeoff, maneuvers at several altitudes, speeds up to Mach 0.8, and mission changes in flight. They described a 30-foot airframe with a 27-foot wingspan and an internal weapons bay.

tech.hed: France will build its next fighter at home after the joint project with Germany collapsed
tech.insight: Defense News reports that Air and Space Force Chief of Staff Jérôme Bellanger told the National Assembly's defense committee on Wednesday that France now treats the future fighter, Avion de Combat du Futur, as a national program meant to fly conventional missions in 2040. France and Germany agreed in June to scrap the joint Future Combat Air System with Spain. Bellanger said Paris remains open to later cooperation that would not structure the aircraft's birth.

culture.hed: Leo called just war outdated because it needs rulers who will judge
culture.insight: Thursday's Providence essay says Pope Leo XIV's encyclical Magnifica Humanitas called just war theory outdated. The writer agrees, but not as a call to drop the tradition: just war is not self-executing. It assumes legitimate political authority, shared moral concepts, and people who will make the hard call.

watch.hed: North Korea fired two submarine-launched cruise missiles Wednesday
watch.note: USNI, Thursday: North Korea fired two submarine-launched cruise missiles Wednesday in the Sea of Japan, the first public disclosure of an SLCM test in nearly three years. State media Korean Central News Agency said the Missile Administration fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles.
